scenario_description:
Objective: Finish drying the already-loaded wet offshore bibs before the 18:00 return-to-boat departure.
Emerging Need: The active locker program must be stopped when the bibs’ care label rules out heat; the equipment itself works and the paid rental remains valid.
Decision Context: Stored garment-care instructions identify air-only drying, open cuffs and the minimum three-hour duration. A free air-only rail within the same rental can complete that preparation if started in time.
Consequence: Once less than three hours remain before collection closes, the documented drying sequence cannot finish before departure; retrieving damp gear or later drying remains possible.

parameter.title: Run MarinaDry cycle for wet bibs
parameter.content: Start a heated locker cycle for the wet offshore bibs and retrieve them before heading back to the boat tonight.

parameter.description: Four-hour heated gear-locker rental for wet offshore bibs.

parameter.subject: MarinaDry rental MD-7714 started in locker H-09
parameter.body: Your four-hour rental MD-7714 has started in locker H-09 with its initial fan-only stage. The standard program will begin heating after its initial check. Ordinary gear collection remains available until18:00 today.

parameter.content: My bibs are loaded and the fan stage started in H-09, but I spotted the laminated-fabric care label warning against heat before the heater came on. I paused the cycle and opened the door. The machine is working; I cannot continue this heated program for these bibs. I am here and need to leave with them at18:00.

parameter.subject: MD-7714: air-only rail available within existing rental
parameter.body: There is space on the ventilated air-only rail in the covered drying loft today. A customer with an active locker rental may move the same gear there using the rental receipt, with no new charge and no support reset. The rail is unheated and accessible now; all gear must be collected when the loft closes at18:00. Please follow the garment care instructions for drying duration and check dryness before packing.

parameter.content: It is15:07 and I still have the damp bibs in the paused locker; I never moved them to the air-only rail. The loft closes at18:00 and I must leave then. I can retrieve the damp gear, but cannot fit the full drying sequence in before departure.
